setupWizard.title: Set up your shop
setupWizard.description: A few quick steps to get your shop ready to sell.

step1.title: Add your first location
step1.description: A branch or warehouse where you'll sell and store stock.
step1.alreadyHaveDescription: You can add more any time from the Locations page.
step1.noPermissionTitle: You don't have permission to add a location
step1.noPermissionDescription: Ask your Company Owner or an Admin to add the first location, then come back here.

step2.title: Choose how your shop works
step2.description: Turn on only what you actually need — you can change these any time.

step3.title: Add units & products
step3.description: Add products one at a time, or import many at once from a spreadsheet.
step3.needUnitDescription: Products need a unit (like Piece or Kg) before you can add them — add one below.
step3.noUnitPermissionDescription: Ask your Company Owner or an Admin to add a unit before you can add products.
step3.noProductPermissionDescription: Ask your Company Owner or an Admin to add your first product.

complete.title: You're all set
complete.description: Your shop is ready. You can always fine-tune everything later from the sidebar.

progress.title: Setup Progress
progress.description: Complete these steps to get your shop fully ready.
progress.allDoneDescription: Your shop is fully set up and ready to go.

SUBSCRIPTION.label: Subscription is active
SUBSCRIPTION.description: Your Platform Admin needs to activate your subscription.

RBAC.label: Owner permissions are assigned
RBAC.description: Your Platform Admin needs to finish setting up your account access.

LOCATION.label: Add a location
LOCATION.description: Add at least one branch or warehouse.

UNIT.label: Add a unit
UNIT.description: Add at least one measurement unit, like Piece or Kg.

PRODUCT.label: Add a product
PRODUCT.description: Add at least one product to start selling.
